asset.description: 四種花的圖鑑(晚香玉/百合/鬱金香/玫瑰線稿圖+名稱)；下方另有A/B/C/D四個花束選項圖需一併裁切

content_en.prompt: A flower shop sells four types of flowers: Tube Rose, Lily, Tulip, Rose — each available in white, yellow and blue. Chitra wants a bunch of six flowers: 1. There must be two of each colour (yellow, white, blue). 2. Flowers of the same type must not have the same colour. 3. Every type of flower should only appear, at most, twice.
content_en.question: Which of the following bunches will Chitra be happy with?
content_en.explanation: A has three white flowers, breaking rule 1 (there must be exactly two of each colour). B has three roses, breaking rule 3 (every type of flower should appear at most twice). C has two flowers of the same type in the same colour, breaking rule 2 (flowers of the same type must not share a colour). Only D has two flowers of each colour, no flower type appearing more than twice, and no two same-type flowers sharing a colour — satisfying all three rules.
content_en.ct_explanation: Computer science often involves solving problems specified by a set of constraints. The task is to find a solution that satisfies all these constraints or as many as possible. More complex tasks combine constraints with logical operators like conjunction (A and B means both must be satisfied, like the three rules here) or disjunction (A or B means satisfying just one is enough).

content_zh.prompt: 一間花店賣四種花：晚香玉、百合、鬱金香、玫瑰，每種都有白、黃、藍三種顏色。Chitra想要一束6朵花的花束，並提出三個條件：1.黃、白、藍三種顏色各要有兩朵。2.同一種花不能有相同顏色。3.每種花最多只能出現兩朵。
content_zh.question: 下面哪一束花束會讓Chitra滿意？
content_zh.explanation: 花束A裡有三朵白花，違反規則1（每種顏色必須剛好兩朵）。花束B裡有三朵玫瑰，違反規則3（每種花最多只能出現兩次）。花束C裡有兩朵同種類又同顏色的花，違反規則2（同一種花不能有相同顏色）。只有花束D同時符合三個條件：每種顏色各兩朵、每種花最多兩朵、而且沒有同種花同色的情形。
content_zh.ct_explanation: 資訊科學裡經常要解決「由一組限制條件所定義」的問題，任務就是找出一個能滿足所有（或盡量多）限制條件的解答。更複雜的任務會用邏輯運算子把限制條件組合起來，例如「且」（A且B表示兩個條件都要滿足，就像這題的三條規則）或「或」（A或B表示只要滿足其中一個就夠了）。
